entities.summary: Ludwig Manfred Lommel (1891–1962) was a German stage and film actor. He was the father of the actress Ruth Lommel and actor Ulli Lommel. His youngest son, Manuel Lommel, is a cinematographer. Ludwig Manfred Lommel was a composers & musicians from Jawor (1891-01-10, Jawor–1962-09-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
